core.fix: Keep core/ pure domain logic with zero external/layer dependencies. Move I/O to platform/ or UI to ui-kit/.

platform.fix: platform/ may only depend on core/ and platform/. Do not import ui-kit/ or features/.

ui-kit.fix: ui-kit/ may only depend on core/ and ui-kit/. Pass data/callbacks via props instead of importing platform/ or features/.

features.fix: features/ may import core/, ui-kit/, or platform/ public interface (platform/index), and must not import another feature or raw I/O modules directly.

routes.fix: server/routes/ must not import fs directly. Use server/scanners/ for reads and server/vault/ for secret writes.

scanners.fix: server/scanners/ is strictly read-only and must not import server/vault/ or server/routes/.

vault.fix: server/vault/ must stay isolated from server/routes/ and server/scanners/.
